content: Kamal loads secrets from .kamal/secrets (dotenv-style, gitignored) which supports variable and command substitution (e.g. calling into 1Password/Bitwarden/LastPass CLIs) so raw secret values need not be stored on disk. deploy.yml separates 'clear' env values (inline, non-secret) from 'secret' values (names only, resolved from .kamal/secrets at deploy time); secrets are written to an env file on the host, not baked into the image.
